summary: German-born investor Peter Thiel co-founded PayPal and Palantir, sold surveillance software to US spies, police and ICE, secretly bankrolled the lawsuit that bankrupted Gawker, and funded anti-democratic and anti-immigration causes on the American right.

evidence.note: Thiel born in Frankfurt in October 1967, family moves to Cleveland in 1968
childhood actually spent in South African-occupied Namibia near the uranium mine
forced-labour-like conditions for Black workers at the Rossing mine his father worked on
Stanford classmates recall him defending apartheid as economically sound
The Diversity Myth co-written with David Sacks, funded by right-wing think tanks
1998 meeting with Max Levchin leads to PayPal
American Thunder NASCAR magazine as a vehicle for right-wing messaging
starts funding Curtis Yarvin and his neo-monarchist city-state ideas around 2008
Clarium's 2008 bets on bank nationalisation and Yahoo lose billions
Palantir founded in 2004 on the PayPal fraud tool, sold to CIA and police
money to Numbers USA and the Tanton anti-immigration network
Palantir software used by ICE to arrest relatives of unaccompanied children

notes: main_span starts at PayPal (1998) per the encyclopedia test; the Stanford Review and Diversity Myth years are in covered_span. Namibia was under South African occupation, hence the polity. electoral-politics (2016 RNC, Vance and Masters donations) and policing-incarceration (LAPD Palantir use) also get segments but were left out to stay within eight secondary themes. No wikidata QID given. The Jeff Thomas suicide is mentioned only briefly, so no warning.
